title: leakdepth: split-unit leakage audits and a cross-corpus lineage screen for network intrusion-detection datasets
description: Python library and command-line tool that derives split units (duplicate, 5-tuple, host pair, session, capture) from flow metadata, audits train/test splits per unit and reports split validity, compares scores across units with class-composition controls, gates continuous-integration jobs on the result, ships a synthetic leakage-injection benchmark with a cross-tool harness, and includes a cross-corpus lineage screen that is not a provenance test. Version 0.1.3 reports, next to each lineage containment, the other matcher's result and a within-corpus baseline, and flags group-bootstrap intervals over fewer than 10 groups. Known limits are documented in README.md and docs/lineage_controls.md.
